#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;

    vector<int> playerA(3), playerB(3);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) cin >> playerA[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) cin >> playerB[i];

    vector<int> playerA_orig = playerA;
    vector<int> playerB_orig = playerB;

    auto max_win_score = [](vector<int> a, vector<int> b) {
        int total_wins = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
            int counter = (i + 1) % 3;
            int wins = min(a[i], b[counter]);
            a[i] -= wins;
            b[counter] -= wins;
            total_wins += wins;
        }
        return total_wins;
    };

    auto max_loss_score = [](vector<int> a, vector<int> b) {
        vector<vector<int>> move_pairs = {{0, 2}, {1, 0}, {2, 1}, {0, 0}, {1, 1}, {2, 2}};
        vector<vector<int>> all_perms;
        // Generate all permutations of move_pairs
        // Since C++11 doesn't have std::next_permutation with initial vector, implement manually
        // but for simplicity, use std::next_permutation
        all_perms.reserve(720); // 6! permutations
        vector<int> indices = {0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5};
        do {
            vector<vector<int>> perm;
            for (int idx : indices) {
                perm.push_back(move_pairs[idx]);
            }
            all_perms.push_back(perm);
        } while (next_permutation(indices.begin(), indices.end()));

        int max_loss = 0;
        for (const auto& perm : all_perms) {
            vector<int> a_copy = a;
            vector<int> b_copy = b;
            vector<int> losses(3, 0);
            for (const auto& move : perm) {
                int loss_amount = min(a_copy[move[0]], b_copy[move[1]]);
                a_copy[move[0]] -= loss_amount;
                b_copy[move[1]] -= loss_amount;
                losses[move[0]] += loss_amount;
            }
            int total_loss = losses[0] + losses[1] + losses[2];
            if (total_loss > max_loss) {
                max_loss = total_loss;
            }
        }
        return max_loss;
    };

    int max_loss = max_loss_score(playerA_orig, playerB_orig);
    int max_win = max_win_score(playerA, playerB);

    cout << (n - max_loss) << " " << max_win << "\n";

    return 0;
}
